label: Market Close
headline: S&P 500 +4.7%, Nasdaq 100 +6.9%, VIX 26.6, WTI $80.17, HPE -8% after hours
stance: Stocks had their best day since April 2025 after Nvidia reinstated its CEO. Treasuries sat still and Williams kept a Dec 9 hike in play.

scorecard.actual: Rally more than doubled. Nasdaq 100 closed +6.9% at 26,746.

scorecard.call: Morning: Treasuries are working as an equity hedge into the Dec 9 FOMC.
scorecard.actual: Not needed today. 10y closed 4.92%, +1bp, while the S&P 500 rose 4.7%.

scorecard.call: Midday: Brent -6.6% on returning supply; VIX 27.4 at 11:33.
scorecard.actual: Both held. Brent $86.72 at the close, -6.3%. VIX closed 26.6.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Fed's Williams: higher rates likely over time; inflation near 2% in 2027 (~4:02pm ET). Dec 9 hike still in play.
WTI settled $80.17, lowest since Aug 26 (~3:52pm ET). Gold +3.2% near $3,654 (~1:57pm ET) despite a firmer dollar.
$69bn 2y auction stopped at 4.700% vs 4.703% when-issued (~1:03pm ET). EUR/USD hit its lowest since April 2025 (~12:21pm ET).

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: S&P 500 seven-day losing streak ended. S&P and Nasdaq Composite posted their best day since April 9, 2025 (~4:25pm ET).
Semiconductor ETF +15.0% at the close. Consumer stocks were among the S&P 500's biggest losers (~4:45pm ET).
Small caps lagged: Russell 2000 +3.4% at the close vs Nasdaq 100 +6.9%.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HYG +0.25%, LQD +0.23% at the close. Credit ETFs rose far less than stocks.

items.head: HPE -8.2% after hours (~6:42pm ET)
items.body: Beat estimates and raised its forecast on AI demand (~4:25pm ET). Stock had closed +17.4%.

items.head: Agilent +7.6% after hours (~6:30pm ET)
items.body: Beat on revenue and earnings per share, plus guidance (~5:40pm ET).

items.head: Zoom -0.2% after hours (~6:40pm ET)
items.body: Beat on revenue and earnings per share, raised its outlook (~4:20pm ET).

items.head: Nvidia closed +31.5% at $165.05
items.body: Largest one-day gain in market history (~4:26pm ET). Trump says the White House assured the board on Huang (~6:15pm ET).

watch.head: Tokyo reopens Tuesday after a holiday
watch.body: First Japanese session since Monday's US chip rally (~5:30pm ET).

watch.head: PCE, GDP, claims, durables, Nov 25, 8:30
watch.body: Last inflation read before the Dec 9 FOMC. US markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving.
